title: Understanding the Model
text: Consider the model equation: $$y_i=\beta_0+x_i \beta_1+f{\left(x_i\right)} \beta_2$$. Think about how the function $$f(x)=|x|$$ might affect the values of $$y_i$$. How does the absolute value function transform $$x$$?

hintAnswer: The pattern suggests a $$V-shape$$, which is characteristic of an absolute value function.
title: Analyzing the Scatterplot
text: Look at the scatterplot. Does the pattern of the data suggest a linear relationship, or does it seem to have a different shape?
choices: The pattern suggests a $$V-shape$$, which is characteristic of an absolute value function.

title: Effect of Absolute Value
text: The absolute value function, $$f(x)=|x|$$, creates a V-shape in the graph. This means that for both positive and negative $$x$$, the output is positive, which can fit data that has symmetry around the y-axis.
